mapper.update: update t800_uv_inexus.t_ins_info_temp set is_activated =#{activateStatus} where device_serial_number= #{deviceSerialNumber}
mapper.select: select b.attachment_name as attachmentName, b.attachment_num as attachmentNum, a.device_serial_number as deviceSerialNumber, b.sample_pool_num as samplePoolNum, b.attachment_type as attachmentKind from t800_uv_inexus.t_ins_info_temp a inner join t800_uv_inexus.t_measure_pool b on a.attachment_type = b.attachment_num inner join t800_uv_inexus.t_device_init_entry c on a.device_model = c.dev_model and c.dev_type_id = b.dev_type where a.device_serial_number = #{device_serial_number}
select activation_status from t_software_activation where device_number = #{deviceSerialNumber}

select b.attachment_name as attachmentName, b.attachment_num as attachmentNum, b.sample_pool_num as samplePoolNum, b.attachment_type as attachmentKind from t800_uv_inexus.t_measure_pool b inner join t800_uv_inexus.t_device_init_entry c on c.dev_type_id = b.dev_type where b.attachment_num = #{attachment_num} and c.dev_model = #{device_model}

select b.attachment_num as attachmentNum, b.sample_pool_num as samplePoolNum, b.attachment_type as attachmentKind from t800_uv_inexus.t_measure_pool b where b.sample_pool_num=1 and b.attachment_name like CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
